Definition: to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit
BiblicalUsage: 1) to release, let drop or loose or rest or fall; 1a) (Qal) to let drop or fall; 1b) (Niphal) to be made to fall down, be thrown down; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to let drop; 1c2) to release, let drop
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
